properties.notes: Former sawmill site in a highly rural location. Despite peripheral setting there is potential for a small-scale residential project through redevelopment of former industrial land. The overall SHLAA site is mixed but the reduced yield indicated recognises a focus on the brownfield parcel. Brownfield element (0.49ha) considered to be suitable for small-scale development - a yield of around 5 dwellings can be calculated based on methodological approach. For indicative purposes in the BF Register, the original SHLAA site (2379) is split to reflect brownfield and greenfield elements - total area of 0.84ha. A saved Tynedale Local Plan allocation for 10 dwellings covers part of site.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
